concepts.label: SDK User Management API (upsertUser/getUsers/getUser/removeUser)
concepts.reused_or_minted: minted - JUDGMENT CALL: this page documents the SDK's own generic programmatic surface for managing Couchbase Server RBAC users (create/list/get/remove), described entirely in the abstract - 'The _String_ specified as the role must correspond to a role supported by Couchbase Server' - with NO specific role name from Server's 56-member catalogue ever mentioned (contrast the paired howto, sdk-user-management-example.md, round 3, which names 'Admin', 'query_manage_index', etc. verbatim). Per this round's framing, since no concrete role:* catalogue entry is named, I minted an SDK-scoped id for the API mechanism itself rather than force-reusing any role:* id - the Server role catalogue is what this API MANAGES, not what this page IS.

concepts.label: a Server RBAC role (coarse data-plane placeholder)
concepts.reused_or_minted: reused - the page's Role{role, bucket_name} object's 'role' field is documented only as a bare string that 'must correspond to a role supported by Couchbase Server', never naming a specific catalogue member, so the coarse generic-role placeholder is the correct fit rather than any individual role:* id.

notable_absence.finding: Unlike its paired howto page (howtos/sdk-user-management-example.md, already extracted in round 3, which names 'Admin', 'data_reader', 'query_select', 'query_manage_index' etc. verbatim in code and prose), this overview documents the entire user-management API surface in the abstract - it never once names a single concrete Server RBAC role from the 56-member catalogue, nor does it state which role is required to CALL upsertUser/removeUser (the example page states this is the Admin role; this overview does not repeat that gate at all). requiresServerRole cannot be populated with any specific role:* object from this page's own text.

cross_component_finding: This page surfaces Server's local/external authentication-domain split (auth-domain:local / auth-domain:external) through the SDK's own User object's 'domain' field and through upsertUser's local-only creation behavior, without ever using the words 'authentication domain' - it just says a created user is 'locally' defined and that LDAP-backed 'external' users 'should not be created by this SDK method'. This is the SDK's client-object-model view of the exact same domain split server/'s own docs describe more formally, confirming the split is a real, cross-product-visible constraint rather than a server-internal-only detail.
cross_product_finding: The Role{role, bucket_name} object described here is purely a Couchbase Server data-plane RBAC construct - bucket-scoped, or wildcarded to every bucket with '*' - with no Capella management-plane concept in view anywhere on this page. This confirms the second judgment call for this batch: this page's 'role' is Server's own RBAC catalogue (rbac-role:role/role:*), the fourth-to-sixth-distinct 'role' thing this ontology tracks, and has no connection on this page to capella-role:* (Capella's org/project-scoped management-plane roles), sgw:role (Sync Gateway's channel-grant bundles), or rbac-model:role (the abstract glossary term).
